title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.24648v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantized neural networks achieve computational efficiency by reducing precision, but bounding their quantization error remains a challenge due to discrete rounding and clamping operations. We present a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework for quantized ReLU feed-forward network verification, introducing a unified round-clamp abstract transformer that jointly handles both operations. We extend this framework to constrained zonotopes, which add linear constraints to tighten bounds, and derive sound quantization error representations. We establish soundness and affine-strip optimality of the round-clamp abstract transformer, as well as convex-hull optimality of its complete constrained formulation. translated_title: 神经网络中量化误差的 Zonotope 分析
translated_abstract: 量化神经网络通过降低数值精度来获得计算效率，但由于离散的舍入和截断操作，对其量化误差进行界定仍然是一个难题。我们提出了一个基于 zonotope 的抽象解释框架，用于量化 ReLU 前馈神经网络的验证，并引入了一个统一的舍入-截断抽象转换器，可同时联合处理这两种操作。我们进一步将该框架扩展到约束 zonotope，通过添加线性约束来收紧误差界，并推导出可靠（sound）的量化误差表示。我们证明了舍入-截断抽象转换器的可靠性与仿射带最优性，以及其完整约束形式的凸包最优性。在 ACAS Xu 基准测试中，在所测试的最小两个扰动半径下，与 QEBVerif 的符号 DRA 传播方法相比，我们的约束 zonotope 方法将平均误差界宽度降低了约 70-85%，并将运行时间缩短了 65-80%。
tldr: 本文提出基于 zonotope 与约束 zonotope 的抽象解释验证框架，通过统一的舍入-截断抽象转换器精确界定量化神经网络的量化误差，在 ACAS Xu 基准上较现有方法将误差界宽度收窄约 70-85%、运行时间缩短 65-80%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework with a unified round-clamp abstract transformer and constrained zonotopes for verifying quantized neural networks, achieving 70-85% tighter error-bound widths and 65-80% faster runtimes than QEBVerif on ACAS Xu benchmarks.
